context_requirements: no dominant p53-inactivating mutation or deletion
falsifiers: no induction of CDKN1A, MDM2, GADD45A, BAX, PMAIP1, SFN, SESN1, TRIB3, DDB2, TP53BP1, RRM2B, FDXR, PLK3, ZMAT3 or TIGAR at 6 h in p53 wild-type lines
no repression of cell-cycle genes such as CCNB1, CDK1, CCNA2, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, PLK1, MCM3, PCNA, UBE2C, CDC20, KIF20A, NUSAP1 or MYBL2 at 24 h
responses in p53-mutant or p53-null lines equal to or greater than in p53 wild-type lines
no difference between p53 wild-type and p53-mutant lines

evidence.supports: Nutlin-3 activates p53 by blocking MDM2-p53 interaction and induces p53 target genes such as PUMA and growth arrest in p53 wild-type cells.
A p53 activator prodrug induces p53 activation, cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis preferentially in p53 wild-type cancer cells.
A small-molecule p53 activator induces apoptosis and ferroptosis through the mitochondrial pathway.
Wild-type p53 can repress Rad51 expression, showing p53-dependent transcriptional repression relevant to DNA repair genes.
